{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
df_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f'Patient-level max sample_seq count: {df_sample_seq.shape[0]}')

# Check assay_batch values
df_assay_batch = df['assay_batch'].value_counts()
print(f'Assay batch distribution:
{df_assay_batch}')"}
